hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (validateQuantityAtLocation loop, around lines 173-192) compares each reservation input alone against level.available_quantity and never sums inputs that share an (inventory_item_id, location_id). Two carts on one server, each holding WIDGET across multiple lines, are each checked against the same untouched level inside the per-item lock; the first reserves, then the second's per-line checks still pass because each line is small, so reserved exceeds stock. I expect at least some runs to show live reservations above stocked 10 (no_oversell fail, and reserved_matches_reservations likely holds since the counter is incremented per batch). Cart A: 5 x OVS-PIECE; cart B: 3 x OVS-PIECE plus 2 x OVS-TWOPACK (7 units). Both are completed together on one server.
